resources.string: Recognize music without an API key. Each tap records 10 seconds and computes a fingerprint on this phone using the open source Audile/SongRec algorithm. Only the fingerprint is sent to Shazam; microphone audio is never uploaded. No background listening. Recognition history stays on this phone.
No match found. Try again near the music.
Recognition failed. Check your microphone and connection, then try again near the music.
Microphone permission is required to record a recognition sample.
